lens: regression - drift between the manuscript and its regenerated artifacts; half-applied corrections; superseded values still standing as current
what_i_read: git log/show on the manuscript and on systems/graph/objects.json
central_claim: The FET-fusion -> impaired-ATM -> compensatory-ATR-dependency hypothesis is not supported by public data for EMC beyond a generic-proliferation signal; the wet-lab ask survives on structural grounds.

blockers.summary: A superseded verdict survives inline in §3.2a: line 380-381 still states, in the present tense, that GSE4303/GPL3290 maps 662 of 41,614 probes at 1.0 % and 'which is why this part reports SIGNATURE_NOT_READABLE' - the exact value and the exact verdict the paper's own Appendix registers as superseded.
blockers.evidence: manuscript line 380-381: 'At a 1.0 % accession yield, **662 of 41,614 probes map and every gene set is left with 0-9 members** - which is why this part reports `SIGNATURE_NOT_READABLE` rather than computing scores from a handful of genes.' Against the artifact AT THIS COMMIT: research/modalities/emc-atr-vulnerability.json -> part_b_emc_tumour_signature.per_platform['GSE4303-GPL3290_series_matrix.txt.gz'].probe_mapping_diagnostic gives n_mapped = 27196 and accession_resolution_rate = 0.582; scores has 12/12 concepts; part_b_emc_tumour_signature.verdict = 'GENERIC_ONLY'. The manuscript's own Appendix (line 918) already lists '"662 of 41,614 probes map" / "1.0 % accession resolution" on GSE4303' as superseded, current statement §3.4; and line 917 lists 'part B's verdict SIGNATURE_NOT_READABLE' as superseded. §3.4 line 407 prints '27,196 (58.2 %, was 662 / 1.0 %)' and line 414 'from 662 to 27,196'. So the correction landed in §3.4 and in the Appendix and NOT in §3.2a, which is the one-of-a-pair pattern this paper has already paid for twice (Appendix line 928).
blockers.what_edit_would_break_it: Rewriting line 380-381 into the past tense and naming the superseded verdict as superseded, e.g. 'At that 1.0 % accession yield only 662 of 41,614 probes mapped and every gene set was left with 0-9 members, which is why the run that had only the curated dictionary reported SIGNATURE_NOT_READABLE. The archived UniGene build removed that blocker (§3.4).' Any edit that leaves a present-tense SIGNATURE_NOT_READABLE in §3.2a re-breaks it.

blockers.summary: The Appendix asserts a correction was fully propagated when it was not: 'the same phrasing propagated to two sibling manuscripts, a producing script, the systems registry and hemcss-label-priorart.json - six copies of a defect graded cheap. All are corrected.' The systems registry still carries the superseded '18-locus STR profile' at the reviewed commit, and so do both of its generated views.
blockers.evidence: manuscript line 927 (Appendix row on the STR marker count) ends 'All are corrected'. At commit 0448a27a6: `git show 0448a27a6:systems/graph/objects.json` line 470 reads "... An 18-locus STR profile exists, so the line is a real, profiled entity ..."; research/manuscripts/emc-systems-map.json carries the same string 3 times (lines 1105, 1599, 1647-adjacent) and research/manuscripts/emc-systems-map.md line 382 carries '18-locus STR concordant across three sources'. The other named copies WERE corrected - research/manuscripts/surface-targets/emc-surface-target-landscape.md:758 and research/manuscripts/no-wet-lab-publication-archetypes.md:694 both read 'an STR profile of 16 markers - 15 STR loci plus amelogenin'; research/modalities/hemcss-label-priorart.json:6 reads '16 markers, 15 STR loci plus amelogenin, over the 18 lines of the Cellosaurus ST block'; research/modalities/emc_model_junction_evidence.py:435 records the number was removed on purpose. So four of the five external copies are fixed and the fifth - the one CLAUDE.md §7 calls the source of truth for the architecture - is not. The correct value is derivable from the artifact the manuscript itself cites: emc-atr-vulnerability.json -> part_a_hemcss_identity.cellosaurus.record.ST has 18 lines, of which one is a 'Source(s):' header and one is a duplicate D13S317 allele call, leaving 16 distinct markers.
blockers.what_edit_would_break_it: Either correct systems/graph/objects.json (and regenerate emc-systems-map.json/.md via emc_systems_map_check.py --write-view), or change the Appendix sentence from 'All are corrected' to name what remains. Restoring '18-locus' anywhere, or restoring the unqualified 'All are corrected' while the registry still says 18, re-breaks it.

blockers.summary: §2.3's whole table is a stale snapshot presented in the present tense. It says 'Every place in the repository that leans on this line - reported, NOT rewritten ... These are for a human decision', and marks five files with an open '⛔ Yes'. At the reviewed commit every one of those files has already been corrected, and each of the strings §2.3 quotes as a live claim survives only inside an explicit 'superseded, retained' block.

Exact-string checks at commit 0448a27a6 (`grep -rn -F` over research/): (a) 'Uses the one real EMC line in DepMap' appears ONLY in this manuscript; research/manuscripts/README.md:110-113 now reads '⛔ Materially amended 2026-08-05 (Amendment 1): the DepMap line it called "the one real EMC line" is recorded by Cellosaurus as NOT carrying an EWSR1 fusion ... - (superseded, retained: this entry read "Uses the one real EMC line in DepMap (H-EMC-SS / ACH-001519, n=1)")'. (b) 'anchors the analysis in an established EMC line' appears ONLY in this manuscript; emc-surface-target-landscape.md carries 'Appendix A1 - Amendment 1 (2026-08-05): the cell line this manuscript called "the one real EMC line" is recorded as NOT carrying the fusion' at line 726. (c) The outreach row is marked '⛔ Yes - and this one is OUTWARD-FACING, so it matters most', but emc-surface-target-outreach.md:125-133 now leads with '⛔ DO NOT claim H-EMC-SS as an EMC line (2026-08-05)' and carries the quoted sentence only as '(Superseded, retained: this draft previously read ...)'. (d) research/IDEAS.md:203 carries the 2026-07-03 correction only under '⛔ Superseded, retained verbatim and quotable:'. (e) emc-surface-target-redteam.md:189 records both readings as 'withdrawn by the 2026-08-05' finding. (f) The target-route-options.md row is likewise closed: line 204 '⛔ 2026-08-05: ... (Superseded, retained: "check whether the one EMC line in DepMap ... has gained CRISPR data since 24Q4")' and line 761 '✅ DONE - and its premise is withdrawn (2026-08-05)'. The landscape row's supporting claim is stale too: it says the file 'already carries authentication/fusion status [to verify] in four places', and `grep -c 'to verify'` on emc-surface-target-landscape.md returns 3, none of them a live flag (line 715 is an unrelated reference-check entry; 733 and 773 are inside the Amendment and its lesson). Every one of these is a $0 grep the paper could have run.
blockers.what_edit_would_break_it: Re-date the section - state that the survey was taken on 2026-08-05 and that the propagation has since been made, or re-run the survey and rewrite the 'does the finding bite?' column against the tree. Leaving the present-tense 'Every place in the repository that leans on this line' or any '⛔ Yes' that reads as an open action re-breaks it.

p1s.summary: The superseded 'PMID 37205599 alone' citation for route 1's mechanism paper still stands in this manuscript's OWN producing script and therefore in its OWN artifact, and in two modality documents the manuscript points readers at - including the preregistration.
p1s.evidence: The Appendix (line ~934) registers 'PMID 37205599 cited alone for route 1's mechanism paper (Menon et al., the bioRxiv preprint)' as superseded, with the version of record Gracilla et al., Cancer Research 2026;86:2660-2677, PMID 41811428. At commit 0448a27a6 the following still cite 37205599 alone, with no mention of 41811428: research/modalities/emc_atr_vulnerability.py line 10 (module docstring) and line 3122; research/modalities/emc-atr-vulnerability.json line 5 `_hypothesis_source` = 'FET fusion oncoproteins ... - bioRxiv 10.1101/2023.04.30.538578 / PMID 37205599' (this is THE artifact §7 says every number in the paper comes from); research/modalities/emc-atri-prereg.md line 92 (the preregistration, cited by §0, §6.2 and §6.3); research/modalities/emc-atri-outreach-DRAFT.md lines 39 and 58 (cited by §8.4); research/modalities/emc_fet_idr_census.py lines 20 and 383 and research/modalities/emc-fet-idr-census.json line 3 (the structural-precondition module cited in §0's 'what still stands' table); research/modalities/emc_fet_construct_designs.py lines 21 and 914 and emc-fet-construct-designs.json line 6. `grep -rn 41811428` finds it in the two dependency manuscripts and in program/emc-post-degrader-options.md only - it reaches no modality script, no modality artifact and no prereg. The paper's own §8.2 sets the standard it fails here: 'the attribution above names both identifiers instead of one'.
p1s.what_edit_would_break_it: Add the version-of-record identifier alongside the preprint in emc_atr_vulnerability.py's `_hypothesis_source` string (which regenerates into the artifact), in emc-atri-prereg.md, and in the two census/construct modules. Leaving the artifact's `_hypothesis_source` naming only 37205599 keeps the defect.

p1s.summary: §3.0a prints 'the broad NR4A3 query returns 10,332' - the artifact has said 10,331 since 2026-08-09. The superseded 10,332 comes from artifact commit ce630e2b4, the exact snapshot the Appendix already names as the source of three other stale claims; this is a fourth survivor of it.
p1s.evidence: manuscript §3.0a, the four-archive table row 'EMBL-EBI BioStudies / ArrayExpress ... 37 hits on the disease name (the broad NR4A3 query returns 10,332 and is not usable as a filter)'. Artifact at this commit: emc-atr-vulnerability.json -> part_b_emc_tumour_signature.dataset_search.biostudies.total_per_query = {'"extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma"': 37, 'NR4A3 sarcoma': 10331}. History: `git log -S'10332' -- research/modalities/emc-atr-vulnerability.json` returns ce630e2b4 (2026-08-05) and 816cbeaac (2026-08-09); `git log -S'10331'` returns 816cbeaac only. Reading the two blobs directly confirms 10332 at ce630e2b4 and 10331 at 816cbeaac and at HEAD. The Appendix's own last-but-one row says 'The snapshot is artifact commit ce630e2b4' and lists n_mapped 20,324, accession_resolution_rate 0.932 and '4,303 -> 4,303 -> 59 linked' as its other survivors - all three of which have been fixed. This one was not. (37 is correct.)

p1s.summary: §3.0a says the GEO search returned '25 EMC-titled SAMPLE records', and repeats it as 'the 25 EMC-titled GSMs'. The artifact returned 25 sample records of which 11 are EMC-titled - in every committed version of the artifact, so this is a mis-transcription in a table the section itself calls the deliverable.
p1s.evidence: manuscript §3.0a table row 'NCBI GEO DataSets | 5 ... | 35 UIDs -> 10 series, plus 25 EMC-titled SAMPLE records', and the paragraph below it 'GEO's DataSets summaries for the 25 EMC-titled GSMs came back with an empty series field'. Artifact: part_b_emc_tumour_signature.dataset_search.geo has n_uids = 35 (correct), 10 series (correct), and len(samples) = 25 of which sum(is_emc_titled) = 11. The 11 are GSM600934-GSM600939, GSM715466/715467/715470/715472 and GSM9037837 - and §3.0 itself lists only ten of them by accession. Checked across artifact commits ce630e2b4, 816cbeaac and ad87aa4c7 (HEAD): 25 samples / 11 EMC-titled in all three, so no regenerated value ever supported 25. The section's own framing is 'when the answer is "nothing readable exists", the search record IS the deliverable', which is what makes a 2.3x overstatement of the EMC-titled yield worth fixing.
p1s.what_edit_would_break_it: State '25 SAMPLE records, 11 of them EMC-titled' and fix the second sentence to '25 GSMs'. Any wording that attaches 'EMC-titled' to 25 re-breaks it.

p2s.summary: The IDR-census artifact still keys the SECOND-commonest EMC fusion as `emc_canonical_EWSR1_NR4A3`, the label the Appendix says was the source of the round-1 headline defect, and it carries no row for the type-1 fusion at all - so of the two homes §0 names for the two-fusion bracket claim, only one supplies both halves.
p2s.evidence: research/modalities/emc-fet-idr-census.json has exactly one EMC entry, `emc_canonical_EWSR1_NR4A3`, with last_fet_residue_retained 264, rg_dipeptides_retained 0/30, breakpoint_provenance 'EWSR1 transcript exon 7' - i.e. the type-2 fusion, still called 'canonical'. The type-1 half (EWSR1(1-431), rg_dipeptides_retained 8/30, junction EWSR1 transcript exon 12 :: NR4A3 exon 3) exists only in research/modalities/emc-fet-construct-designs.json under construct EWSR1_NR4A3_type1. §0's 'what still stands' row cites both emc_fet_idr_census.py and emc_fet_construct_designs.py as its home. Both printed figures are correct against the construct-designs artifact; the residual is the census artifact's naming, which is the label the Appendix says drifted.

p2s.summary: §3.2a's 're-queried 2 accessions out of 65,180' for GPL3290 is present tense and does not match the current artifact, where n_accessions_newly_queried for GPL3290 is 915.
p2s.evidence: manuscript §3.2a: 'An accession whose query failed was recorded as tried, so the 16-sample GPL3290 platform - the one that matters - re-queried 2 accessions out of 65,180. Only accessions NCBI actually answered are marked now.' Artifact per_platform['GSE4303-GPL3290_series_matrix.txt.gz'].probe_mapping_diagnostic: n_distinct_accessions 65180 (correct), n_accessions_newly_queried 915, n_accessions_from_committed_cache 2, n_accessions_from_cross_platform_cache 2, and ncbi_global_budget_exhausted (NCBI was never queried for this platform). The Appendix registers '`n_accessions_newly_queried: 2` on GPL3290' as superseded and points at §3.2a as the current statement, so the pointer lands on the copy that still carries the superseded number. Historical narrative, so lower weight than the §3.2a blocker above, but the tense is the same defect.

p2s.summary: §8.1 says GSE299349 was 'released Jun 04 2026'; the artifact field that carries that date is `last_update_date`, not a release date.
p2s.evidence: atr-hrd-sarcoma-series.json -> series_record: {'submission_date': 'Jun 09 2025', 'last_update_date': 'Jun 04 2026'}; no release field is recorded. The GEO DataSets search in emc-atr-vulnerability.json independently gives GSE299349 pdat 2026/06/04, which is consistent with a Jun-2026 release, so the statement is probably right - but the artifact does not record a release date, and the manuscript's own discipline is that a populated field is not a measured one.

_verdict_note: The science checks out against the artifacts and both producers reproduce; every drift I found is in the self-audit and provenance layer plus one section-level verdict statement, and none of it requires re-analysis. Three blockers, all textual. Clean, re-derived from the artifact at this commit: all of part C (6 genes x 5 columns, the coordination block -0.048/+0.013/t -0.41/1-of-20/3-of-71, and the instrument block -1.340/-0.0065/0.190, which is axis_sd_sarcoma_pool and not ATM's panel SD as it first looks); all of part D (the 4 mechanism rows with their per-drug splits, the whole 7-drug table, the five expression predictors in the -0.15 to -0.17 band, SE 0.038 at n~700, the 2.7-7.1x inhibitor disagreement, doxorubicin absent from GDSC2 8.5); all of §3.4 on both series including the ATM sign and the S-phase/checkpoint pair that round 1 transposed, 20,629/98.2%, 27,196/58.2%, 2,653 genes named, five elink errors as 3x502 + 2xIncompleteRead, UniGene 130,056 clusters / 6,365,381 accessions, curated dictionary 44,976; §3.1's 27 classified GSE4303 samples and the 10/3/3, 4 and 2 splits; §1's cut values +0.178 (t 3.33) and +0.218 (t 5.08), which really are the pooled values, the verbatim predicate at emc_atr_vulnerability.py line 2321, the cited line range 2309-2322, DEPENDENT_THRESHOLD = -0.5 at depmap_sarcoma_dependency.py line 97 (imported by emc_atr_vulnerability.py line 76, so the attribution is exact), and `git log -S` confirming neither cut has moved since 2026-08-05; all of part A (1,670 models, both fusion calls verbatim, NR4A3 0.941 / 83.1st percentile / median 0.214 / 1,673 lines, 16 distinct markers in the Cellosaurus ST block, 21 Europe PMC records, the caution quoted verbatim); §0's structural bracket against emc-fet-construct-designs.json (type 1 = exon 12::exon 3, EWSR1(1-431), 8/30; type 2 = exon 7::exon 2, EWSR1(1-264), 0/30); and the whole of §8 - 68 vs 62 design gap, every subtype count, the 67/1 platform split with GSM9037837 alone on GPL34281, PMID 41651400 with its doi and full author list, 54 sentences stored with _version_read PREPRINT, the 156,566-byte cache fetched 2026-08-27, every identity-check TPM and rank, and the claim that the producer now asks Europe PMC for 41811428 first, which atr_hrd_sarcoma_series.py lines 118-119 and 311-312 confirm. `emc_atr_vulnerability.py --check` returned REPRODUCES and `atr_hrd_sarcoma_series.py --check` returned a bound slot and a byte-identical re-derivation.
